Design tells the merge helper at Alignment.behavior.ts:327-335 to return the final none|unique|ambiguous|exhausted union, but that helper only provisionally reports ambiguous/exhausted while an accumulator may hold one match and must keep scanning; unique/none are not honest mid-scan states. Inline it or name a distinct continue|ambiguous|exhausted control result.

Reader migration underspecifies exact/lesser ambiguity: live bestAlignedMatch only fail-closes on minimalFold.exhausted/ambiguous (:465-470) and otherwise reads exact.match/lesser.match (:473-489), so exact/lesser ambiguous merely drops that tier. Design must give an exhaustive decision table/tests so tagged ambiguous from the three-member subset is not accidentally treated as terminal.

No cardinality gap: writers at todo-item.tsx:139-148 can produce all four isToday/isOverdue pairs, including combined-true for an incomplete earlier-today timestamp; the :17-27 if/else-if only prioritizes today. Inventory legal=3 is false, so the E2-only qualification lacks the required representable>legal gap.

Design builds DueDateTone on the false 4/3 gap and cannot advance as this boolean-creep instance; a separate UI refactor would also need DECISIONS.md browser-qa-loop evidence for the due-badge presentation change, not only unit cases.

Cardinality representable=4 undercounts the listed members: isBinary plus independently optional bytes/text already yield 8 presence combinations (16 with sibling optional data), while close/error/message currently share those optionals at XAi.models.ts:440-478. E1/E3 at XAi.service.ts:703-719 still show two intended message writes, but the inventory 4/2 gap is wrong.

Encoded-side impact cannot be none as written: XAiWebSocketEvent is an exported schema/type (XAi.models.ts:469-527; package index re-export) and the public session stream element type (XAi.service.ts:146), so nesting message and deleting flat isBinary/bytes/text/data changes decoded TS and encoded property layout. Either Tier-2 compat preserving legacy flat encoded names/inputs, or an explicit never-shipped-encoding proof plus named atomic consumers (root export, events contract, encode/decode fixtures)—not an open-ended Search-all inventory.
